title: White House Confirms New Talks Between US Russia and Ukraine to End War
text: White House Confirms New Talks Between US Russia and Ukraine to End WarMetroTV, The White House says meaningful progress has been made in new trilateral talks between the United States, Russia, and Ukraine, as President Donald Trump continues efforts to end the ongoing war. Officials emphasized the administration’s focus on reaching a peace agreement and ending the loss of lives on both sides. Meanwhile, questions remain over Ukraine’s position in negotiations and broader global tensions, including reports of joint naval exercises involving Russia and Iran. The White House declined to comment on specific presidential decisions but reaffirmed its commitment to diplomacy and peace efforts.
